A.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Equalize fraction units
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fractional parts as equivalent fractions so they can be subtracted.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when a step converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with the same denominator before subtraction.
Tag for mixed-number items when only the fractional parts are rewritten to a common denominator.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag simple rewriting of a whole number as n + 0/d unless it is part of creating a common denominator for unlike fractional parts.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps.

skills.name: Normalize composite numbers
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or nonstandard mixed number into a usable whole-and-fraction form before subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized, such as 2 3/2 to 3 1/2.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus a zero-fraction, such as 3 to 3 + 0/5.
Tag when the solver explicitly restructures a number into separate whole and fractional parts to set up subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary common-denominator conversion of proper fractions.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping after subtraction has begun.
Do not tag the final combining of whole and fractional results.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract quantities once they are in compatible form, including numerators of like fractions and the whole and fractional parts of mixed numbers.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators of fractions with the same denominator are subtracted.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted directly.
Tag when subtraction produces an intermediate negative fractional part before any borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is finding a common denominator or rewriting numbers into standard form.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps that adjust the whole and fraction after a negative fractional result.
Do not tag simplification-only steps such as reducing 2/10 to 1/5 or 0/3 to 0.

skills.name: Regroup and simplify result
skills.definition: Borrow from the whole part when needed and express the final difference in lowest terms or integer/mixed-number form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when 1 whole is borrowed and converted into denominator-over-denominator fractional units.
Tag when a fraction or zero result is simplified, such as 2/10 to 1/5, 9/12 to 3/4, or 0/3 to 0.
Tag when the solver combines the adjusted whole and fractional parts into the final mixed number or integer after regrouping or simplification.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag direct subtraction steps that do not involve regrouping or simplification.
Do not tag initial normalization of whole numbers or improper mixed numbers.
Do not tag common-denominator conversion before subtraction.

B.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers, including common-denominator subtraction, denominator alignment, regrouping, normalization, and simplification

skills.name: Align fraction forms
skills.definition: Rewrite quantities into compatible fractional forms before subtraction, such as finding a common denominator or expressing a whole number with a zero fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution finds an LCD/common denominator and converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a mixed form like n + 0/d to match the other term's denominator.
Tag when fraction parts are explicitly rewritten so the subtraction can be performed with matched denominators.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no rewriting is performed.
Do not tag mere classification statements like 'Type C' or 'Type E' unless an actual rewrite/conversion is carried out.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number into a standard mixed number; that belongs to S02.

skills.name: Normalize mixed numbers
skills.definition: Convert a nonstandard mixed number with an improper fractional part into an equivalent standard mixed number before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number such as 2 3/2 or 1 4/3 is rewritten as an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag when the solver explicitly states 'normalize' and changes the whole and fractional parts accordingly.
Tag when the rewrite removes an improper fraction part from a mixed number before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary common-denominator conversions between fractions.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as n + 0/d; that belongs to S01.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping during subtraction; that belongs to S04.

skills.name: Subtract corresponding parts
skills.definition: Carry out the subtraction of numerators for like-denominator fractions and/or subtract the whole-number and fractional parts of mixed numbers when no regrouping is needed yet.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts fractions with a shared denominator, such as 20/12 − 9/12 or (6−4)/7.
Tag when the solution subtracts whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers directly.
Tag when the subtraction step produces either a final result or an intermediate negative fractional part before any borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag denominator-finding or equivalent-fraction conversion; that belongs to S01.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers; that belongs to S02.
Do not tag the borrowing/regrouping step itself; that belongs to S04.

skills.name: Regroup and simplify
skills.definition: Resolve subtraction results by borrowing/regrouping across whole and fractional parts when needed and reduce the resulting fraction or zero form to lowest terms/final form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when 1 whole is borrowed and converted into denominator-over-denominator units to continue subtraction.
Tag when a fraction result is simplified, such as 2/10 to 1/5, 9/12 to 3/4, or 0/3 to 0.
Tag when regrouping and final reduction are used to express the answer in lowest terms or integer form.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag straightforward subtraction steps that do not involve borrowing or simplification beyond the raw subtraction.
Do not tag common-denominator setup or rewriting whole numbers as n + 0/d; that belongs to S01.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers; that belongs to S02.

C.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Equalize fraction units
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fractional parts as equivalent fractions so they can be subtracted.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when one or both fractions are converted to equivalent fractions before subtraction.
Tag for mixed-number items when only the fractional parts need denominator alignment.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the fractions already have the same denominator and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag for rewriting a whole number as a mixed number with 0 over an existing denominator unless no denominator change occurs.
Do not tag for simplification after subtraction.

skills.name: Normalize composite forms
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or nonstandard mixed number into a compatible form for subtraction, such as adding a 0-fraction part or converting an improper mixed number to a standard mixed number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a mixed number with a zero fractional part, such as 3 = 3 + 0/5.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized, such as 2 3/2 = 3 1/2.
Tag when the rewrite is done to make whole and fractional parts directly comparable before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for borrowing or regrouping after subtraction has begun.
Do not tag for finding a common denominator between two proper fractions.
Do not tag when the item is already in directly usable standard form and no rewrite occurs.

skills.name: Subtract with regrouping
skills.definition: Carry out the subtraction of whole and/or fractional parts, including borrowing one whole into fractional units when the fractional part would otherwise be negative.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted for like-denominator fractions.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts are subtracted in mixed-number or whole-number contexts.
Tag when the solution borrows or regroups one whole into fractional units to complete the subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for merely rewriting numbers into compatible forms before subtraction.
Do not tag for reducing the final fraction or converting 0 over a denominator to 0 after subtraction.
Do not tag for combining already-computed whole and fractional results into final notation without performing subtraction.

skills.name: Simplify and express result
skills.definition: Reduce the subtraction result to lowest terms and present it in an appropriate final form such as a fraction, mixed number, or integer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is simplified, such as 2/10 = 1/5 or 9/12 = 3/4.
Tag when 0 over a denominator is simplified to 0 or when a zero fractional part is omitted from a mixed number.
Tag when whole and fractional parts are combined into the final mixed number or integer form.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for the subtraction computation itself.
Do not tag for finding common denominators or converting to equivalent fractions.
Do not tag for preparatory rewrites like converting a whole number to include a 0-fraction part.
